proposed_rules.trigger: A stack of single-column [2x1] zones each with an eyebrow/H2/paragraph, heights varying (not uniform), alternating down a long landing page, some with bg:color, some plain.
proposed_rules.decision: Map each row as its own section with default-content (eyebrow+H2+paragraph+optional CTA link); background-container-is-section-style handles the colored ones. Do not group rows into one repeating block.
proposed_rules.rationale: Rejected alternative: treat the whole stack as one repeating-cards block (repeating-cards-are-one-block) — rejected because row heights and content shapes differ significantly (626,545,730,518,567,510px), indicating distinct hand-authored sections, not uniform repeating items.

proposed_rules.trigger: A nested [bg:gradient] widget directly below the hero headline offering multiple selectable build-type options.
proposed_rules.decision: Model as its own block (e.g. option-selector/tabs) inside the hero section, separate from the hero text default-content.
proposed_rules.rationale: Rejected alternative: fold the widget into the hero block as one cell — rejected because it is an interactive selector with its own repeating option structure, distinct from plain hero copy.

proposed_rules.trigger: A short, childless node (no text) sitting between confirmed content nodes, at a height/position consistent with a button/CTA row.
proposed_rules.decision: Flag for Phase 2 targeted DOM extraction to recover button label/link rather than treating as empty space.
proposed_rules.rationale: minWidth capture strips interactive button markup, leaving a blank placeholder node; dropping it would lose a CTA.

notes: Landing/promo page with a gradient hero, a widget-driven build-type picker, and a long stack of alternating feature rows before an FAQ accordion and footer.
